name: Ashton-under-Lyne Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food parcels and support to local residents in crisis. Open Mondays and Thursdays.

name: Ashton-under-Lyne Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Boulder Knowle Park with 20 plots
months: this garden provides growing space for residents and grows produce for local food bank donations.

name: Ashton-under-Lyne Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at Ashton Library reducing food waste
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food and access free items. Open during library hours.
